title: Gampong di Pante Sidang .
intro: Kamoe meurumpok droe kamoe di saboh gampong bineh laot, di sinan su gelombang meujampu ngon bisikan-bisikan ureung nyang ka tuwoe. Awaknyan geubri peurintah keu geu-istirahat, teuma keucewa awaknyan jipeujeuet huköman nyang mantong jipeugah ngon su nyang hana meu-ulang-ulang. Jeut neubuka soe awak nyan?
clues: Kamoe tinggai bak binéh panté dan geubri peurintah keu kamoe peuraya uroe istirahat.
Bak uroë njan, eungkôt akan djidjak bak kamoë deungon le that, tapi kamoë djitham untôk cok.
Na nyang peuingat keu pelanggaran, tapi na nyang meukomplot keu meulayang pakriban pih.
Kamoe meulanggar peurintah suci dan kamoe peuteuka huköman nyang brat that ateueh droe kamoe.
Hukôman geutanjoë nakeuh saboh transformasi njang peugot geutanjoë ka meu-ulang-ulang dan meu-hina.
Kamoe ka jeuet keu kera, sibagoe tanda keu mandum ureuëng nyang teuma teuka lheueh nyan.
arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًۭا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. (7:163)
